objective: pathsOverlap in server/repos/factory.ts (~L1009) ends a glob's literal stem only at '*', while matchesGlob treats '?' as a wildcard. So pathsOverlap(['src/?.ts'],['src/a.ts']) is false although both cover src/a.ts, letting two units that own one file be leased concurrently, and a leading './' defeats the comparison (pathsOverlap(['./src/a.ts'],['src/**']) is false). Fix: cut the stem at the first of * ? [ {, and normalise a leading './' and backslash separators before comparing; an empty stem stays maximally overlapping. Also confirm ownershipReachesForbidden('.git?ub/**',['.github/**']) is now refused, if that function builds on the same stem.
expectedOutcome: Two globs that can cover the same path always overlap.

acceptanceConditions.statement: pathsOverlap reports an overlap for '?' wildcards and for a leading './', with a test that fails before the fix

rollbackRequirement: Revert the commit; no schema or data change.
